skill.name: Notion API
skill.description: Connect AI assistants to Notion pages, databases, search, and block content through the official Notion API.
skill.summary: Search, read, create, and update shared Notion workspace content with Bun scripts.
skill.author: BLTGV

security_audit.summary: Static findings were adjudicated as false positives caused by Markdown backticks, TypeScript template literals, Notion IDs, and official Notion URLs. No prompt injection or covert exfiltration was found. The remaining concerns are contextual: the skill can read shared workspace content and modify Notion pages with the user token.

remediation.issue: Broad workspace read access through NOTION_TOKEN
remediation.suggestion: Document least privilege setup clearly and ask users to share only the pages and databases needed for each workflow.

remediation.issue: Page create, update, and archive operations can change workspace data
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before POST or PATCH operations, including the target page or database title when available.

remediation.issue: Recursive block reads have no depth limit
remediation.suggestion: Add a maximum recursion depth option and default to a conservative depth to reduce accidental large reads.

remediation.issue: Scripts return full page and database property objects
remediation.suggestion: Offer a field selection or redaction option for sensitive properties before returning results to the assistant.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Notion Workspace Read Access
semantic_findings.description: The skill can search shared Notion pages and databases, then return page and block content to the assistant. Any content shared with the integration may appear in outputs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation advertises workspace search and block reads, and the scripts POST to /search and fetch block children. This is expected behavior but creates a data exposure risk if token scope is broad.

semantic_findings.title: Notion Content Modification Capability
semantic_findings.description: The skill can create pages, update page properties, change icons, and archive or restore pages through the user token. Accidental or unconfirmed use can modify workspace data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented update examples include archiving pages, and pages.ts sends POST and PATCH requests to Notion. The risk is contextual because writes require a valid NOTION_TOKEN.

semantic_findings.title: Recursive Block Reads Lack Depth Limit
semantic_findings.description: Recursive block listing can traverse nested page content without a documented depth cap. This can increase data exposure and cause excessive API requests on large pages.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The recursive option calls listBlocks again for child blocks with no depth counter. Notion page sharing still limits access, so the severity is low.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast access to trusted Notion workspace content from their assistant. This skill lets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code search, read, create, and update shared Notion content.
actual_capabilities: Search shared Notion pages and databases with optional text and object filters.
Retrieve page metadata, parent information, properties, icons, covers, and URLs.
Create new pages under a page or database with titles, icons, and properties.
Update page titles, icons, archive state, and database page properties.
Query databases with Notion filters, sorts, and result limits.
List page or block children, including optional recursive block traversal.
limitations: Requires a NOTION_TOKEN environment variable from a Notion integration.
Can access only pages and databases shared with that integration.
Depends on the Notion API and its rate limits.
Does not create or edit database schemas.

use_cases.title: Find Workspace Knowledge
use_cases.description: Search shared Notion pages and databases, then summarize the most relevant results for a question.

use_cases.title: Update Project Records
use_cases.description: Query a project database and update selected task properties after confirmation.

use_cases.title: Draft New Notion Pages
use_cases.description: Create meeting notes, briefs, or database entries inside an approved parent page or database.

prompt_templates.title: Search Notion
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Notion workspace for pages about quarterly planning. Show the top five matches with titles and links.

prompt_templates.title: Read Page Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the Notion page with this ID and summarize its main sections. Include important open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Query a Database
prompt_templates.prompt: Query this Notion database for tasks where Status is In Progress. Sort by last edited time and summarize the top ten.

prompt_templates.title: Update After Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an update for this Notion page to set Status to Done. Show the exact target and wait for my confirmation before writing.

output_examples.input: Search Notion for project launch notes.
output_examples.output: Returns matching shared pages and databases with titles, object types, links, archive status, and last edited times.

output_examples.input: Read the content blocks from a page.
output_examples.output: Provides a structured summary of headings, paragraphs, task items, code blocks, links, captions, and nested sections when requested.

output_examples.input: Update a task page after confirmation.
output_examples.output: Confirms the selected page, applies the requested Notion property changes, and reports the updated title, URL, and edit time.

best_practices: Use a dedicated Notion integration with the smallest required page access.
Confirm all create, update, and archive actions before running write commands.
Start with narrow search terms and small result limits before broad workspace searches.
anti_patterns: Do not share entire workspaces with the integration when one page is enough.
Do not paste Notion tokens into prompts or page content.
Do not run archive or property updates without checking the target page first.

faq.question: What authentication does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a NOTION_TOKEN environment variable from a Notion integration that you control.

faq.question: Can it read every page in my workspace?
faq.answer: No. It can read only pages and databases shared with the Notion integration.

faq.question: Can it create or edit Notion pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create pages, update properties, change icons, and archive or restore pages.

faq.question: Does it support Notion database queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can get database details and query entries with filters, sorts, and result limits.

faq.question: Does it store Notion data locally?
faq.answer: No evidence found that the scripts persist Notion responses to local files.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
